ok.outcome:
CASE WHEN event = 'beta.installed' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('imported', 'import-failed', 'fresh') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'beta.left' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('trash', 'keep') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE CASE WHEN outcome IN ('ok', 'error') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END END

ok.flavor: CASE WHEN flavor IN ('beta', 'remote') THEN flavor ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.process_type: CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END ELSE '' END
ok.reason:
CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE
  WHEN reason IN ('clean-exit', 'abnormal-exit', 'killed', 'crashed', 'oom', 'launch-failed', 'integrity-failure', 'memory-eviction', 'unknown') THEN reason
  WHEN substr(reason, 1, 5) = 'code='
  AND (CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END) IN ('backend', 'server')
  AND (substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' OR (length((CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND (CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
  AND (instr(reason, ' ') = 0 OR substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) IN ('signal=null', 'signal=SIGABRT', 'signal=SIGALRM', 'signal=SIGBUS', 'signal=SIGCHLD', 'signal=SIGCONT', 'signal=SIGFPE', 'signal=SIGHUP', 'signal=SIGILL', 'signal=SIGINT', 'signal=SIGIO', 'signal=SIGIOT', 'signal=SIGKILL', 'signal=SIGPIPE', 'signal=SIGPOLL', 'signal=SIGPROF', 'signal=SIGPWR', 'signal=SIGQUIT', 'signal=SIGSEGV', 'signal=SIGSTKFLT', 'signal=SIGSTOP', 'signal=SIGSYS', 'signal=SIGTERM', 'signal=SIGTRAP', 'signal=SIGTSTP', 'signal=SIGTTIN', 'signal=SIGTTOU', 'signal=SIGURG', 'signal=SIGUSR1', 'signal=SIGUSR2', 'signal=SIGVTALRM', 'signal=SIGWINCH', 'signal=SIGXCPU', 'signal=SIGXFSZ')) THEN 'code=' || CASE WHEN substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' THEN 'null' ELSE CAST(CAST(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) END
    || CASE WHEN instr(reason, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) END
  ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN CASE WHEN reason IN ('timeout', 'network', 'http-client', 'http-server', 'manifest', 'release-feed', 'verification', 'cancelled', 'unknown') THEN reason ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE '' END

CASE WHEN event = 'beta.installed' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('imported', 'import-failed', 'fresh') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'beta.left' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('trash', 'keep') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE CASE WHEN outcome IN ('ok', 'error') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END END
ok.platform: CASE WHEN platform IN ('darwin', 'win32', 'linux') THEN platform ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.arch: CASE WHEN arch IN ('arm64', 'x64', 'ia32', 'arm') THEN arch ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.source: CASE WHEN source IN ('main', 'renderer') THEN source ELSE '' END
ok.flavor: CASE WHEN flavor IN ('beta', 'remote') THEN flavor ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.process_type: CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END ELSE '' END
ok.reason:
CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE
  WHEN reason IN ('clean-exit', 'abnormal-exit', 'killed', 'crashed', 'oom', 'launch-failed', 'integrity-failure', 'memory-eviction', 'unknown') THEN reason
  WHEN substr(reason, 1, 5) = 'code='
  AND (CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END) IN ('backend', 'server')
  AND (substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' OR (length((CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND (CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
  AND (instr(reason, ' ') = 0 OR substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) IN ('signal=null', 'signal=SIGABRT', 'signal=SIGALRM', 'signal=SIGBUS', 'signal=SIGCHLD', 'signal=SIGCONT', 'signal=SIGFPE', 'signal=SIGHUP', 'signal=SIGILL', 'signal=SIGINT', 'signal=SIGIO', 'signal=SIGIOT', 'signal=SIGKILL', 'signal=SIGPIPE', 'signal=SIGPOLL', 'signal=SIGPROF', 'signal=SIGPWR', 'signal=SIGQUIT', 'signal=SIGSEGV', 'signal=SIGSTKFLT', 'signal=SIGSTOP', 'signal=SIGSYS', 'signal=SIGTERM', 'signal=SIGTRAP', 'signal=SIGTSTP', 'signal=SIGTTIN', 'signal=SIGTTOU', 'signal=SIGURG', 'signal=SIGUSR1', 'signal=SIGUSR2', 'signal=SIGVTALRM', 'signal=SIGWINCH', 'signal=SIGXCPU', 'signal=SIGXFSZ')) THEN 'code=' || CASE WHEN substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' THEN 'null' ELSE CAST(CAST(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) END
    || CASE WHEN instr(reason, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) END
  ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN CASE WHEN reason IN ('timeout', 'network', 'http-client', 'http-server', 'manifest', 'release-feed', 'verification', 'cancelled', 'unknown') THEN reason ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE '' END

CASE WHEN event = 'beta.installed' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('imported', 'import-failed', 'fresh') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'beta.left' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('trash', 'keep') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE CASE WHEN outcome IN ('ok', 'error') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END END

ok.process_type: CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END ELSE '' END
ok.reason:
CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE
  WHEN reason IN ('clean-exit', 'abnormal-exit', 'killed', 'crashed', 'oom', 'launch-failed', 'integrity-failure', 'memory-eviction', 'unknown') THEN reason
  WHEN substr(reason, 1, 5) = 'code='
  AND (CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END) IN ('backend', 'server')
  AND (substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' OR (length((CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND (CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
  AND (instr(reason, ' ') = 0 OR substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) IN ('signal=null', 'signal=SIGABRT', 'signal=SIGALRM', 'signal=SIGBUS', 'signal=SIGCHLD', 'signal=SIGCONT', 'signal=SIGFPE', 'signal=SIGHUP', 'signal=SIGILL', 'signal=SIGINT', 'signal=SIGIO', 'signal=SIGIOT', 'signal=SIGKILL', 'signal=SIGPIPE', 'signal=SIGPOLL', 'signal=SIGPROF', 'signal=SIGPWR', 'signal=SIGQUIT', 'signal=SIGSEGV', 'signal=SIGSTKFLT', 'signal=SIGSTOP', 'signal=SIGSYS', 'signal=SIGTERM', 'signal=SIGTRAP', 'signal=SIGTSTP', 'signal=SIGTTIN', 'signal=SIGTTOU', 'signal=SIGURG', 'signal=SIGUSR1', 'signal=SIGUSR2', 'signal=SIGVTALRM', 'signal=SIGWINCH', 'signal=SIGXCPU', 'signal=SIGXFSZ')) THEN 'code=' || CASE WHEN substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' THEN 'null' ELSE CAST(CAST(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) END
    || CASE WHEN instr(reason, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) END
  ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN CASE WHEN reason IN ('timeout', 'network', 'http-client', 'http-server', 'manifest', 'release-feed', 'verification', 'cancelled', 'unknown') THEN reason ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE '' END

ok.process_type: CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END ELSE '' END
ok.reason:
CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE
  WHEN reason IN ('clean-exit', 'abnormal-exit', 'killed', 'crashed', 'oom', 'launch-failed', 'integrity-failure', 'memory-eviction', 'unknown') THEN reason
  WHEN substr(reason, 1, 5) = 'code='
  AND (CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END) IN ('backend', 'server')
  AND (substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' OR (length((CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND (CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
  AND (instr(reason, ' ') = 0 OR substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) IN ('signal=null', 'signal=SIGABRT', 'signal=SIGALRM', 'signal=SIGBUS', 'signal=SIGCHLD', 'signal=SIGCONT', 'signal=SIGFPE', 'signal=SIGHUP', 'signal=SIGILL', 'signal=SIGINT', 'signal=SIGIO', 'signal=SIGIOT', 'signal=SIGKILL', 'signal=SIGPIPE', 'signal=SIGPOLL', 'signal=SIGPROF', 'signal=SIGPWR', 'signal=SIGQUIT', 'signal=SIGSEGV', 'signal=SIGSTKFLT', 'signal=SIGSTOP', 'signal=SIGSYS', 'signal=SIGTERM', 'signal=SIGTRAP', 'signal=SIGTSTP', 'signal=SIGTTIN', 'signal=SIGTTOU', 'signal=SIGURG', 'signal=SIGUSR1', 'signal=SIGUSR2', 'signal=SIGVTALRM', 'signal=SIGWINCH', 'signal=SIGXCPU', 'signal=SIGXFSZ')) THEN 'code=' || CASE WHEN substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' THEN 'null' ELSE CAST(CAST(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) END
    || CASE WHEN instr(reason, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) END
  ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN CASE WHEN reason IN ('timeout', 'network', 'http-client', 'http-server', 'manifest', 'release-feed', 'verification', 'cancelled', 'unknown') THEN reason ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE '' END

ok.process_type: CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END ELSE '' END
ok.reason:
CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE
  WHEN reason IN ('clean-exit', 'abnormal-exit', 'killed', 'crashed', 'oom', 'launch-failed', 'integrity-failure', 'memory-eviction', 'unknown') THEN reason
  WHEN substr(reason, 1, 5) = 'code='
  AND (CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END) IN ('backend', 'server')
  AND (substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' OR (length((CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND (CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
  AND (instr(reason, ' ') = 0 OR substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) IN ('signal=null', 'signal=SIGABRT', 'signal=SIGALRM', 'signal=SIGBUS', 'signal=SIGCHLD', 'signal=SIGCONT', 'signal=SIGFPE', 'signal=SIGHUP', 'signal=SIGILL', 'signal=SIGINT', 'signal=SIGIO', 'signal=SIGIOT', 'signal=SIGKILL', 'signal=SIGPIPE', 'signal=SIGPOLL', 'signal=SIGPROF', 'signal=SIGPWR', 'signal=SIGQUIT', 'signal=SIGSEGV', 'signal=SIGSTKFLT', 'signal=SIGSTOP', 'signal=SIGSYS', 'signal=SIGTERM', 'signal=SIGTRAP', 'signal=SIGTSTP', 'signal=SIGTTIN', 'signal=SIGTTOU', 'signal=SIGURG', 'signal=SIGUSR1', 'signal=SIGUSR2', 'signal=SIGVTALRM', 'signal=SIGWINCH', 'signal=SIGXCPU', 'signal=SIGXFSZ')) THEN 'code=' || CASE WHEN substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' THEN 'null' ELSE CAST(CAST(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) END
    || CASE WHEN instr(reason, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) END
  ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN CASE WHEN reason IN ('timeout', 'network', 'http-client', 'http-server', 'manifest', 'release-feed', 'verification', 'cancelled', 'unknown') THEN reason ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE '' END

ok.outcome:
CASE WHEN event = 'beta.installed' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('imported', 'import-failed', 'fresh') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'beta.left' THEN CASE WHEN outcome IN ('trash', 'keep') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE CASE WHEN outcome IN ('ok', 'error') THEN outcome ELSE 'unknown' END END
ok.platform: CASE WHEN platform IN ('darwin', 'win32', 'linux') THEN platform ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.arch: CASE WHEN arch IN ('arm64', 'x64', 'ia32', 'arm') THEN arch ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.source: CASE WHEN source IN ('main', 'renderer') THEN source ELSE '' END
ok.flavor: CASE WHEN flavor IN ('beta', 'remote') THEN flavor ELSE 'unknown' END
ok.process_type: CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END ELSE '' END
ok.reason:
CASE WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN CASE
  WHEN reason IN ('clean-exit', 'abnormal-exit', 'killed', 'crashed', 'oom', 'launch-failed', 'integrity-failure', 'memory-eviction', 'unknown') THEN reason
  WHEN substr(reason, 1, 5) = 'code='
  AND (CASE WHEN process_type IN ('main', 'renderer', 'backend', 'server', 'Browser', 'GPU', 'Utility', 'Zygote', 'Sandbox helper', 'Pepper Plugin', 'Pepper Plugin Broker', 'unknown') THEN process_type ELSE 'unknown' END) IN ('backend', 'server')
  AND (substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' OR (length((CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND (CASE WHEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 1, 1) = '-' THEN substr(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6), 2) ELSE substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) END) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'))
  AND (instr(reason, ' ') = 0 OR substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) IN ('signal=null', 'signal=SIGABRT', 'signal=SIGALRM', 'signal=SIGBUS', 'signal=SIGCHLD', 'signal=SIGCONT', 'signal=SIGFPE', 'signal=SIGHUP', 'signal=SIGILL', 'signal=SIGINT', 'signal=SIGIO', 'signal=SIGIOT', 'signal=SIGKILL', 'signal=SIGPIPE', 'signal=SIGPOLL', 'signal=SIGPROF', 'signal=SIGPWR', 'signal=SIGQUIT', 'signal=SIGSEGV', 'signal=SIGSTKFLT', 'signal=SIGSTOP', 'signal=SIGSYS', 'signal=SIGTERM', 'signal=SIGTRAP', 'signal=SIGTSTP', 'signal=SIGTTIN', 'signal=SIGTTOU', 'signal=SIGURG', 'signal=SIGUSR1', 'signal=SIGUSR2', 'signal=SIGVTALRM', 'signal=SIGWINCH', 'signal=SIGXCPU', 'signal=SIGXFSZ')) THEN 'code=' || CASE WHEN substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) = 'null' THEN 'null' ELSE CAST(CAST(substr(reason, 6, instr(reason || ' ', ' ') - 6) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) END
    || CASE WHEN instr(reason, ' ') = 0 THEN '' ELSE ' ' || substr(reason, instr(reason, ' ') + 1) END
  ELSE 'unknown' END
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN CASE WHEN reason IN ('timeout', 'network', 'http-client', 'http-server', 'manifest', 'release-feed', 'verification', 'cancelled', 'unknown') THEN reason ELSE 'unknown' END
      ELSE '' END
ok.error_context: CASE WHEN error_context IN ('check', 'download', 'install') THEN error_context ELSE '' END

      CASE WHEN length(fingerprint) BETWEEN 8 AND 32 AND instr(fingerprint, char(0)) = 0 AND fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'
        THEN fingerprint ELSE '0000000000000000' END AS fingerprint,
      tab	separated AS 😀,
.leading AS title,
a AS home
    FROM events
  ), diagnostic_events AS (
    SELECT diagnostic_metadata.*, CASE
      WHEN event = 'app.error' THEN 'err:' || fingerprint
      WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN 'crash:' || process_type || ':' || reason
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN 'update:' || error_context END AS issue_key
    FROM diagnostic_metadata
  )

      CASE WHEN length(fingerprint) BETWEEN 8 AND 32 AND instr(fingerprint, char(0)) = 0 AND fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'
        THEN fingerprint ELSE '0000000000000000' END AS fingerprint,
      ünïcödé AS 2,
﻿bomns:key.path AS 10,
a:b:c AS nav
    FROM events

    SELECT diagnostic_metadata.*, CASE
      WHEN event = 'app.error' THEN 'err:' || fingerprint

      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN 'update:' || error_context END AS issue_key
    FROM diagnostic_metadata
  )

      CASE WHEN length(fingerprint) BETWEEN 8 AND 32 AND instr(fingerprint, char(0)) = 0 AND fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'
        THEN fingerprint ELSE '0000000000000000' END AS fingerprint,
      src/a/b.ts AS b,
line1
line2😀 AS home
    FROM events
  ), diagnostic_events AS (
    SELECT diagnostic_metadata.*, CASE
      WHEN event = 'app.error' THEN 'err:' || fingerprint
      WHEN event IN ('app.renderer-crash', 'app.child-process-crash') THEN 'crash:' || process_type || ':' || reason
      WHEN event = 'update.error' THEN 'update:' || error_context END AS issue_key
    FROM diagnostic_metadata
  )
